entries.title: Psalms 5:1
segments: Meditation and prayer should be united, and the early part of each day spent in communion with God, and in supplication for his presence and blessing in all its duties and enjoyments.

entries.title: Psalms 5:2
segments: My King; to whom he would yield obedience.

entries.title: Psalms 5:5
segments:
The foolish; wicked. 
 
  Not stand; not be approved, but condemned.

entries.title: Psalms 5:6
segments: To be abhorred by the Lord of hosts is one of the greatest evils that can come upon the children of men, and one which, by repentance of sin and faith in Jesus Christ, they should all be most anxious to avoid.

entries.title: Psalms 5:7
segments: Thy house--thy temple; for the public worship of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 5:8
segments:
Make thy way straight before my face; open before me a plain and safe path in which I may walk withouit stumbling.  God's way is here the way in which he leads the psalmist.  It is a way of protection as well as of obedience. 
 
When the righteous man is surrounded by enemies he has peculiar need of earnest prayer to be kept from any false step that shall give them an occasion to blaspheme.

entries.title: Psalms 5:9
segments:
Their mouth; the mouth of my enemies, who are also the enemies of God and righteousness. 
 
  An open sepulchre; ready to swallow up and destroy.  Compare

entries.title: Psalms 5:10
segments: Destroy thou them; if they turn not from their sins thou wilt destroy them, and all thy people will approve of thy judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 5:11
segments: Those who have chosen God as their portion, and who put their trust in him, have cuase for habitual and ever-increasing joy.
